Definition: Dodanites, or descendants of a son of Javan
BiblicalUsage: The Dodanim, or Rodanim, were the descendants of Javan, named in the table of nations among the sons of Japheth. Their name means leaders.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sons of Javan are named because the nations that came from them, the peoples of the coasts and islands, were never outside God's sight.
